mapper.sql: I.ID AS "id" ,I.SELLER_ID AS "sellerId" ,U.NICKNAME AS "sellerName" ,I.CATEGORY AS "category" ,I.TITLE AS "title" ,I.PRICE AS "price" ,I.ITEM_COND AS "cond" ,I.TRADE_TYPE AS "tradeType" ,I.REGION AS "region" ,I.STATUS AS "status" ,I.VIEW_CNT AS "views" ,I.LIKE_CNT AS "likes" ,I.CHAT_CNT AS "chats" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM I.BUMP_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "bumpAt" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM I.INS_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "insAt" ,(SELECT P.ID FROM T_MARKET_PHOTO P WHERE P.ITEM_ID = I.ID ORDER BY P.ORD, P.ID LIMIT 1) AS "photoId" ,I.PREV_PRICE AS "prevPrice"
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_MARKET_ITEM (SELLER_ID, CATEGORY, TITLE, PRICE, DESCRIPTION, ITEM_COND, TRADE_TYPE, REGION) VALUES (#{sellerId}, #{category}, #{title}, #{price}, #{description}, #{cond}, #{tradeType}, #{region})
mapper.select:
SELECT
,I.DESCRIPTION AS "description" ,I.REPORT_CNT AS "reports" ,I.BUYER_ID AS "buyerId" ,(SELECT B.NICKNAME FROM T_USER B WHERE B.ID = I.BUYER_ID) AS "buyerName"
,EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_MARKET_LIKE L WHERE L.ITEM_ID = I.ID AND L.USER_ID = #{me}) AS "liked"
,FALSE AS "liked"
FROM T_MARKET_ITEM I JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = I.SELLER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND I.ID = #{id} AND I.DEL_DAY IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE T_MARKET_ITEM SET VIEW_CNT = VIEW_CNT + 1 WHERE ID = #{id}
UPDATE T_MARKET_ITEM SET BUMP_DAY = NOW() WHERE 1=1 AND ID = #{id} AND SELLER_ID = #{sellerId} AND DEL_DAY IS NULL AND STATUS = 'SALE' AND BUMP_DAY < NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_MARKET_ITEM WHERE 1=1 AND SELLER_ID = #{sellerId} AND INS_DAY >= (DATE_TRUNC('day', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_MARKET_ITEM WHERE 1=1 AND SELLER_ID = #{sellerId} AND DEL_DAY IS NULL AND STATUS IN ('SALE', 'RESERVED')

SELECT U.NICKNAME AS "nickname" ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_MARKET_ITEM I WHERE I.SELLER_ID = U.ID AND I.DEL_DAY IS NULL AND I.STATUS IN ('SALE', 'RESERVED'))::INT AS "itemCount" ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_MARKET_ITEM I WHERE I.SELLER_ID = U.ID AND I.DEL_DAY IS NULL AND I.STATUS = 'SOLD')::INT AS "soldCount" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM U.INS_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "joinedAt" FROM T_USER U WHERE U.ID = #{sellerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_MARKET_PHOTO (ITEM_ID, ORD, CONTENT_TYPE, BYTES, DATA, THUMB) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{ord}, #{contentType}, #{bytes}, #{data}, #{thumb,jdbcType=BINARY})
mapper.select: SELECT ID FROM T_MARKET_PHOTO WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId} ORDER BY ORD, ID
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM T_MARKET_PHOTO WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId} AND ID = #{photoId}
mapper.update: UPDATE T_MARKET_PHOTO SET ORD = #{ord} WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId} AND ID = #{photoId}
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN #{thumb} AND P.THUMB IS NOT NULL THEN 'image/jpeg' ELSE P.CONTENT_TYPE END AS "contentType" ,CASE WHEN #{thumb} AND P.THUMB IS NOT NULL THEN P.THUMB ELSE P.DATA END AS "data" FROM T_MARKET_PHOTO P JOIN T_MARKET_ITEM I ON I.ID = P.ITEM_ID WHERE 1=1 AND P.ID = #{id} AND I.DEL_DAY IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_MARKET_LIKE (USER_ID, ITEM_ID) VALUES (#{userId}, #{itemId}) ON CONFLICT (USER_ID, ITEM_ID) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM T_MARKET_LIKE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND ITEM_ID = #{itemId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_MARKET_CHAT (ITEM_ID, BUYER_ID, ROOM_ID) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{buyerId}, #{roomId}) ON CONFLICT (ITEM_ID, BUYER_ID) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE T_MARKET_ITEM SET CHAT_CNT = CHAT_CNT + 1 WHERE ID = #{itemId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_MARKET_REPORT (ITEM_ID, USER_ID, REASON) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{userId}, #{reason}) ON CONFLICT (ITEM_ID, USER_ID) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: UPDATE T_MARKET_ITEM SET REPORT_CNT = REPORT_CNT + 1 ,STATUS = CASE WHEN REPORT_CNT + 1 >= #{limit} THEN 'HIDDEN' ELSE STATUS END WHERE ID = #{itemId} RETURNING REPORT_CNT
SELECT U.ID AS "userId" ,U.NICKNAME AS "nickname" FROM T_MARKET_CHAT C JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = C.BUYER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND C.ITEM_ID = #{itemId} AND U.DEL_DAY IS NULL ORDER BY C.INS_DAY DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT BUYER_ID FROM T_MARKET_ITEM WHERE ID = #{itemId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_MARKET_REVIEW (ITEM_ID, WRITER_ID, TARGET_ID, WRITER_ROLE, RATING, TAGS, COMMENT) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{writerId}, #{targetId}, #{writerRole}, #{rating}, #{tags,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{comment,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ON CONFLICT (ITEM_ID, WRITER_ID) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_MARKET_REVIEW WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_MARKET_REVIEW WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId} AND WRITER_ID = #{writerId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE RATING = 3)::INT AS "good" ,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE RATING = 2)::INT AS "ok" ,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE RATING = 1)::INT AS "bad" FROM T_MARKET_REVIEW WHERE TARGET_ID = #{userId}

SELECT R.RATING AS "rating" ,R.TAGS AS "tags" ,R.COMMENT AS "comment" ,R.WRITER_ROLE AS "writerRole" ,W.NICKNAME AS "writerName" ,I.TITLE AS "itemTitle" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM R.INS_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "at" FROM T_MARKET_REVIEW R JOIN T_USER W ON W.ID = R.WRITER_ID JOIN T_MARKET_ITEM I ON I.ID = R.ITEM_ID WHERE R.TARGET_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY R.ID DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT KEYWORD FROM T_MARKET_KEYWORD WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY INS_DAY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_MARKET_KEYWORD (USER_ID, KEYWORD) VALUES (#{userId}, #{keyword}) ON CONFLICT (USER_ID, KEYWORD) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM T_MARKET_KEYWORD WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND KEYWORD = #{keyword}
mapper.select: SELECT K.USER_ID AS "userId" ,MIN(K.KEYWORD) AS "keyword" FROM T_MARKET_KEYWORD K JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = K.USER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND U.DEL_DAY IS NULL AND K.USER_ID <> #{sellerId} AND POSITION(LOWER(K.KEYWORD) IN LOWER(#{title})) > 0 GROUP BY K.USER_ID LIMIT 300
mapper.update: UPDATE T_MARKET_ITEM SET PREV_PRICE = #{prevPrice,jdbcType=BIGINT} WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID FROM T_MARKET_LIKE WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId} LIMIT 300

SELECT I.ID AS "id" ,I.TITLE AS "title" ,I.PRICE AS "price" ,I.STATUS AS "status" ,I.REPORT_CNT AS "reports" ,U.NICKNAME AS "sellerName" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM I.INS_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "insAt" ,(SELECT STRING_AGG(R.REASON, ' / ' ORDER BY R.INS_DAY DESC) FROM T_MARKET_REPORT R WHERE R.ITEM_ID = I.ID) AS "reasons" ,(SELECT P.ID FROM T_MARKET_PHOTO P WHERE P.ITEM_ID = I.ID ORDER BY P.ORD, P.ID LIMIT 1) AS "photoId" FROM T_MARKET_ITEM I JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = I.SELLER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND I.DEL_DAY IS NULL AND (I.REPORT_CNT > 0 OR I.STATUS = 'HIDDEN') ORDER BY (I.STATUS = 'HIDDEN') DESC, I.REPORT_CNT DESC, I.ID DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE T_MARKET_ITEM SET STATUS = CASE WHEN STATUS = 'HIDDEN' THEN 'SALE' ELSE STATUS END ,REPORT_CNT = 0 ,UPD_DAY = NOW() WHERE ID = #{id} AND DEL_DAY IS NULL
